description.content:
Unofficial HTTP API reference for Ekşi Sözlük, reverse-engineered from Android app 2.4.10 build 144. This project is not affiliated with Ekşi Teknoloji.

## Authentication modes

Public reads still require an app bearer token. Use the anonymous-token flow when no user account is needed. Account reads and all writes require a logged-in account token. Secured requests send both `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` and `Client-Secret: <uuid>`.

## Api-Secret

Authentication requests include an `Api-Secret` form field containing RSA/ECB/PKCS1Padding encrypted app metadata. See the [reverse-engineering notes](https://github.com/agmmnn/eksiapi/blob/master/docs/apk-analysis.md) and [Python implementation](https://github.com/agmmnn/eksiapi/blob/master/eksiapi/auth.py).

## Running requests

The generated Postman collection can create anonymous and account sessions without Python. Its authentication scripts generate `Api-Secret` and keep credentials and session values in Postman Local Vault. When using the OpenAPI contract in another client, supply `Api-Secret`, bearer-token and `Client-Secret` values yourself. Never publish or share account passwords, access tokens, refresh tokens or client secrets.

## Stability

This is an unofficial reverse-engineered contract. Endpoint behavior may change when the Android application is updated. Operations marked with `x-eksi-risk` change account state or expose private account data.
